notes.title: 2023/04/24 fix
notes.notes:
1. Add guidance system
Press T or the back button of the handle, Red will say the current information
(If the archive is blank before reading, it is normal, and the information will not be displayed until the next stage
If you don't know what level to do now, you can go to the guide to watch the simple strategy)
2. Increase running speed switching
Press the Y key on the keyboard to greatly increase the running speed, you can switch according to the situation
3. A park map is added near the game start
4. Fix some hints
5. If you have saved the battery before, please do not choose to ask the dialogue again
The current prompt may be washed out (the new game process has been corrected, the dialogue will not appear)
